workstreamName: Instant V2 Overview/Property Intelligence section switching
operatorOutcome: Switching between V2 Overview and Property Intelligence for deal 81 feels immediate; the property record is loaded once and reused across sections; no research reruns, no stale data, no long loading animation; URL navigation and browser history keep working.

requirements.text: Overview <-> Property Intelligence switching is perceptually immediate in the live localhost workflow.
The full property record is not unnecessarily refetched or rebuilt on every section change.
Canonical-read freshness is preserved; no stale data is introduced.
URL navigation and browser history keep working for both sections.

steps: Switch to Property Intelligence and back to Overview at least 6 times
Confirm each switch renders perceptually immediately (content visible well under a second after first load)
Confirm via network requests that tab switches do not refetch the full property record or trigger research reruns
Use browser back/forward and confirm section navigation still works
Refresh on each section and confirm correct content persists

requiredVisibleOutcomes: Must NOT occur: A section switch still takes multiple seconds or refetches the full property record every time
Must NOT occur: Tab switching triggers research reruns
Must NOT occur: Stale data is shown after underlying data changes
Must NOT occur: URL or history navigation breaks
Must NOT occur: The delay is hidden behind a long loading animation instead of removed
mandate: Actively attempt to prove the implementation wrong; never repeat the builder's conclusions.
Open the actual running localhost dashboard in a real browser.
Navigate the full affected workflow; click every relevant control and open every affected tab.
Exercise relevant forms, maps, filters, tables, links, and actions.
Compare visible frontend output with API responses and, when appropriate, database records.
Compare visible output with accepted operator facts.
Refresh the browser and verify persistence; when restart persistence is required, restart via npm run landos:restart and reopen the workflow.
Capture fresh screenshots and exact reproduction steps for every failure.
Judge business meaning and operator usability, not merely whether pages load.
Return a non-passing result whenever an internally fixable issue remains.
After repairs, run the exact same journey again.
